exposure: growth during infancy (Weight-for-age z-score (WAZ) at age 2 years, weight-for-height z-score (WHZ) at age 4, height-for-age z-score (HAZ) at 4 years, WAZ at age 4, relative conditional weight at 4 years, conditional weight gain at age 2-4)
cohort: The study followed 5,914 children born in 1982 in the urban area of Pelotas, southern Brazil, with valid IMT measurements obtained for 3,188 individuals at age 30.
finding: Carotid intima-media thickness (IMT) at age 30 was positively associated with weight-for-age z-score at age 2 years, weight-for-height z-score at age 4, height-for-age z-score at age 4, weight-for-age z-score at age 4, and conditional weight gain at age 4 years.
